fold.description: Map each code point in U+0041..U+005A to the code point 0x20 higher, in U+0061..U+007A. Leave every other code point unchanged.
fold.notes: Deliberately not 'lowercase the name'. Java's String.toLowerCase is locale-sensitive by default, so under a Turkish locale QUERIES folds to querıes and the offender is missed; Go's strings.ToLower uses simple case mapping where JavaScript, Python and Rust use full, so U+0130 becomes i there and i+U+0307 here. Exactly two code points in Unicode lower into ASCII (U+0130 and U+212A), so this rule differs from full lowering only at those two, and it can only ever add a segment boundary, never remove one.

split.description: Divide the folded name into maximal runs of U+0061..U+007A and U+0030..U+0039. Discard empty runs. Every other code point is a separator.
split.notes: A segment match is a whole-run match, never a substring match. This is what keeps a single-token service prefix such as bigquery from splitting into a spurious query.
